appearance: Dry clear daylight, slightly hazy horizon.
terrain_character: Low drygrassbanks, short palms andpatchyplanting, tanlargegravelrunoff; explicitclimbtowardT3andbowlsection.
distinctive_geometry: The main pit building has a white garage base, long dark glazing, several deeply projecting angled roof slabs and slender upper columns. Keep the pit wall separate.
The main grandstand has long crowd terraces under a thin angular cantilevered roof, with open steel bracing beneath.
Outside the long bowl are separate crowd terraces and angular roof sections, behind broad tan escape areas.
The main pit footprint188019421 is centered near native669m, facing grandstand169886092 near697m. Two end groups have deep projecting roof slabs above a lower garage base.
A tall white timing pylon with a dark position display is observed near the infield braking approach around native3080m; its position is estimated.

sectors.name: Final T15 exit and T16
sectors.observed: The final slow left T16 lies near native304m. Red-white kerbs and green paint lead onto the long pit straight. The stepped pit roof volumes and main grandstand appear ahead; low grass and paved/gravel escape remain outside.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: Pit straight and start/finish
sectors.observed: The main grandstand is on the left, mapped OSM169886092 near697m. The pit and control roof complex is on the right, OSM188019421 near669m. Deep layered roof slabs, white garages, a separate pit wall and green verge define the straight. The finish line is seen near116s; approximate native station470m.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T1, T2 and uphill T3
sectors.observed: T1 is the right near1041m, T2 the left near1165m, and T3 the uphill right hairpin near1429m. The road dips into T2 and climbs strongly toward the blind crest. Braking boards, green/blue paint and an open crowd terrace frame the hairpin.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: Back straight and T4
sectors.observed: The long fast straight descends through grass and palms. Guardrail, mesh and distance boards define the approach to T4. The slow right apex has a broad green paved escape and tan runoff beyond. Stands and pit buildings stay distant.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T5–7 infield
sectors.observed: The wide left-left-right sequence crosses a low rise. Red-white kerbs border green, yellow and red paved escape areas. A white timing pylon with a dark position panel appears beside the braking approach. Low grass banks and distant stands leave an open horizon.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T8–9 bowl approach
sectors.observed: Linked corners lead toward the bowl. Red-white kerbs and green paint border the asphalt; tan runoff widens outside. Separate pale grandstand roof sections appear ahead, with dry grass and scattered palms.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T10–12 continuous right bowl
sectors.observed: The multi-apex right is continuous. Inside grass and red-white kerbs follow the arc, with green/red paint leading to broad tan gravel outside. Large crowd terraces and separated angular roof sections sit beyond the escape area.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T13–14 fast changes
sectors.observed: Sweeping direction changes cross broad grass and painted edges. The main facilities gradually return to view, with gravel outside and fences behind the escape areas.
sectors.registration: Approximate route intervals registered from the FIA map, actual mapped pit/stand footprints and reference corner order. Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16, notSF.

sectors.name: T15 approach and exit
sectors.observed: The late right bends lead into the short link toward T16 across the station seam. Kerbs, grass, green paint and paved/gravel escape border the sequence. The long pit straight begins after the final left at native304m, rather than inside this interval.

dimensions_policy: OSM XY footprints are registered geographic evidence. Tagged height and levels are retained verbatim; missing/zero heights are unknown. Roof/detail sizes and sparse-vegetation spacing in native authoring are visual estimates pending cockpit comparison.

source_registration.method: Nearest native centerline sample after retained local tangent projection and uniform scale.
source_registration.landmark_extent_note: Centroid station can fall on adjacent arm of circuit; use actual ring and terrain, not centroid station alone. Overlapping compound roof footprints must never become solid road obstructions.

replacement_profile.provider: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, retained bounded scenery raster
replacement_profile.vertical_datum: Relative to the minimum sampled GLO-30 centerline value.
replacement_profile.interpolation: Exact native XY centerline inverted to retained WGS84 origin/scale, bilinear raster sampling. Two circular[1,2,1]/4 passes at4m sample spacing. No vertical scale factor.
replacement_profile.limitations: 30m digital surface model, not lidar or bare-earth road survey. Canopy and roof influences remain possible. Geographic source pixels are retained with provenance; no reference video pixels redistributed.
replacement_profile.structural_findings: Correct route registration putsT1near1041m,T2near1165m,T3near1429m. The GLO-30 climb fromT2toT3is11.738m, compared with7.832m from the coarse deck. The mapped pit straight is400–1000m, not4870m.

primary_sources.title: ABB Contact India3/2011, electrical supplier account of Buddh project
primary_sources.supports: Supplier quotes14m highest elevation and18–20m track width. This is a venue-specification summary, not a station-resolved civil survey.

required: Cockpit contact sheet covering all sectors, including each landmark approach and both road edges.
No floating tiles, barriers crossing drivable lane, closed escape mouths, or faceted long curves.
Compare curb colour/extent, runoff surface/depth, fencing, tree placement and skyline per sector against timestamps.
Review night illumination for asphalt visibility and dark sky, or daylight landscape contrast as appropriate.
acceptance.status: Reference inventory and scene recipe authored; native runtime acceptance is separate.

authored_edges.side_convention: Numeric+1 is driver right, -1 is driver left. Shader runoff widths clamp to exported collision shoulders.
authored_edges.registration: Intervals visually estimated against mapped native curves and supplied video; not a surveyed curb or safety-installation trace.
authored_edges.physical_escape_review: Large terminal escape mouths still need explicit footprint geometry and matching collision-barrier changes. Surface ribbons must not extend through existing collision walls.
authored_edges.outer_kerb_paint: Selected reference-observed kerbs have a 2.6 m green strip from the road edge, leaving green beyond the raised red-white blocks. These strips are independent of the larger outer escape surfaces.

native_scene_status: Authored geometry and type checks complete. Native cockpit review and collision acceptance are pending.
scenery_grounding: Mapped buildings use the lowest footprint terrain level. Stand fronts have retaining bases and rear supports extend to sampled terrain. Trees avoid all road arms and mapped building footprints.

additional_authoritative_data.title: NRSC Bhuvan CartoDEM standards
additional_authoritative_data.status: Official 30 m CartoDEM is a DSM from Cartosat stereo, with quoted 8 m height accuracy and 15 m positional accuracy. Download requires an account.
additional_authoritative_data.limitation: This is an independent coarse cross-check, not a bare-earth circuit survey or enough to resolve small racing crests.

source_conflicts: Retained city footprints can cross the modeled road corridor. Native facade authoring clips ground walls outside the road mask plus 1.2 m and records the removed area; these are disclosed registration conflicts, not validated building surveys.
uncertainties: Native source origin is in the final sector beforeT16. SF is estimated near470±100m, T1near1041m, T2near1165m, T3near1429m. Geographic pit and grandstand footprints establish this route phase.
